description: This file defines the 'TransferStats' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, representing transfer data after an HTTP request, including request and response objects, transfer time, handler statistics, and errors.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: A class encapsulating details about an HTTP transfer, including request/response objects, transfer timing, and error info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TransferStats object with request, response, timing, error data, and handler stats.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request object associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response object received, or null if none.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerErrorData
methods.description: Returns handler-specific error data, which could be an exception, error code, or other.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI to which the request was sent.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Returns the estimated transfer time in seconds.

methods.name: getHandlerStats
methods.description: Returns an array of handler-specific transfer statistics.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler statistic by name.
